ENDPOINT.primary: mRNA (firefly-luciferase and SARS-CoV-2 RBD) delivery by ionizable LNP; luciferase reporter transfection in vitro, bioluminescence in vivo, plus vaccine immunogenicity.
ENDPOINT.evidence: Abstract (Europe PMC): '96-member biodegradable ionizable lipid library, stereodefined H9T6 emerged as the lead ionizable lipid... DoE identified an H9T6:DOPG:cholesterol:PEG composition (40:16:43.5:0.5 mol %) that achieved more than 3.5-fold higher dendritic-cell transfection than SM-102'. SI Figures S2-S5 are luciferase activity relative to SM102 in DC2.4 and C2C12.
ENDPOINT.second_experiment_in_same_paper: UTR engineering (3'UTR half-life, 5'UTR ribosome loading). This varies the CARGO, not the lipid. MUST NOT be pooled with the lipid/formulation screen (trap 5).

WHERE_THE_VALUES_ARE.headline: The tier-1 publisher workbook is NOT a lipid screen. The 96-lipid screen is in main-text Fig 1B-G, which is not on disk and is paywalled. Every ionizable-lipid delivery value reachable from the files on disk is a FORMULATION DoE on ONE lipid (H9T6), in raster SI bar charts.

by_source.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Tier 1: the only publisher Source Data file is the 3'UTR workbook above, which contains no luciferase values. Tier 2: the SI has 11 tables (S1-S11); none carries per-formulation luciferase numbers — S1 is composition, S2/S3 are UTR sequences, S4-S10 are toxicology parameter lists, S11 is immunogenicity ratios for 4 named vaccine groups only. Tier 3: no author repository — find_repo.py over GitHub for DOI/PMID/title/author Cha returned no candidate authored by this group (two unrelated lipid-ML repos only). Tier 4: the figure has no text layer; pdfplumber returns only the caption, and the panel is a single flattened raster.

only 3 bars each (SM102, crude H9T2, crude H9T6) and BOTH y-axes are BROKEN (discontinuous, two segments with different scales). axis.calibrate cannot describe a broken axis with one affine/log map; a single calibration over a broken axis is exactly error class 20/27 territory. Not extracted.
